title: SG-4 · Integrate Phaser 3.90 with a lifecycle-safe React host and typed events
summary: Phaser 3.90 runs inside a React host with one game instance, pixel-art settings, resize handling, a typed event bus and Zustand-owned shared state.
description: Context: game/frontend is a React 18 + Vite + zustand app. SceneView.tsx renders the bedroom as an plus absolutely positioned hotspot buttons. useGame.ts keeps GameState in React useState, and uiStore.ts holds only UI flags. Phaser is not installed and no src/phaser folder exists. Desired behavior: install Phaser 3.90 and add a PhaserHost React component that owns exactly one Phaser.Game, with pixel-art config, resize and device-pixel-ratio handling. Add a typed event bus for Phaser to React and React to Phaser messages. Move shared GameState into a Zustand store that Phaser reads without duplicating it. Expected result: unit tests with Phaser mocked prove single-instance creation, cleanup on unmount, resize handling and typed event delivery. Why: it is the base for the layered Phaser scene work in later sub-goals.
acceptance_criteria: Given package.json, When dependencies are read, Then phaser resolves to a 3.90.x version.
Given PhaserHost mounts under React.StrictMode, When effects run twice, Then the Phaser game factory returns exactly one live instance and destroys the first before the second is created.
Given PhaserHost unmounts, When cleanup runs, Then game.destroy(true) is called once and no instance remains.
Given the game config, When it is built, Then pixelArt and roundPixels are true and scale mode is FIT with integer-friendly zoom.
Given a typed event is emitted on the bus, When a listener is subscribed, Then the listener receives the exact typed payload and no payload after unsubscribe.
Given GameState changes in the Zustand store, When a Phaser scene reads it, Then it gets the store value and keeps no copy.

in_scope: pixel-art game config and scale helper
Zustand game store read by a Phaser scene
preserve: useGame return shape: state, scene, view, act, choose

technical_constraints: Tests under game/frontend/tests, run with vitest run
Unit tests must mock the phaser module
definition_of_done: All requirements delivered with Act and Verify units
Unit tests pass and tsc --noEmit passes
non_functional: No duplicate Phaser instances or listener leaks
